title: Service Page Details

fields.label: Editing a service page
fields.message: Safe to duplicate: duplicate the Local SEO reference page, then replace the content below. These fields control copy and media only; the design and page structure are protected. Complete each tab from left to right.

fields.label: Service name (public name)
fields.name: service_name
fields.instructions: Short public name used in headings and navigation, e.g. Local SEO.

fields.label: Hero title
fields.name: hero_title
fields.instructions: Use <em> around one accent phrase only.

fields.label: Hero proof point
fields.name: hero_proof
fields.instructions: Verified proof only.

fields.label: Hero evidence visual style
fields.name: evidence_type
fields.instructions: Selects the fixed dashboard-style visual in the hero. Choose the option that best matches the service; the visual layout is handled automatically.

fields.label: Evidence visual: business name
fields.name: evidence_business
fields.instructions: Business name shown inside the hero evidence visual.

fields.label: Evidence visual: metric 1
fields.name: evidence_calls
fields.instructions: First display value in the hero evidence visual. Use a short value only, e.g. 186 or 42%.

fields.label: Evidence visual: metric 2
fields.name: evidence_directions
fields.instructions: Second display value in the hero evidence visual. Use a short value only.

fields.label: Evidence visual: metric 3
fields.name: evidence_position
fields.instructions: Third display value in the hero evidence visual. Use a short value only.

fields.label: Outcome strip (3–4 proof points)
fields.name: outcomes
fields.instructions: Add 3–4 concise outcomes shown directly below the hero. The layout and order are applied automatically.

fields.label: Workstream display style
fields.name: workstream_layout
fields.instructions: Choose how the same workstream content is displayed. “Sticky blueprint” is the recommended default; changing this affects presentation, not the text itself.

fields.label: Proof mode
fields.name: proof_mode
fields.instructions: Never publish placeholder or fabricated metrics.

fields.label: Linked case study (when selected above)
fields.name: proof_case_study
fields.instructions: Choose an existing Case Study only when Proof mode is “Service-specific case study”. Leave blank for agency-wide proof or a hidden section.

fields.label: Proof context label
fields.name: proof_context
fields.instructions: Clearly label agency-wide proof when it is not service-specific.

fields.label: FAQ section mode
fields.name: faq_mode
fields.instructions: Use the standard FAQs, replace them with the rows below, or hide the FAQ section completely.

choices.default: Use standard FAQs unless rows are added

fields.label: FAQ section heading
fields.name: faq_title
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank to keep the standard service-page heading.

fields.label: FAQ section introduction
fields.name: faq_sub
fields.instructions: Optional short paragraph shown below the FAQ heading.

fields.label: Purchase-decision FAQs
fields.name: faqs
fields.instructions: Add, remove, or drag rows to reorder the questions. Select Custom FAQ rows above if an empty list should hide this section.

fields.label: Optional long-form service guide
fields.name: service_guide
fields.instructions: Appears after the primary sales journey. Leave blank to hide.

fields.label: Final CTA title
fields.name: final_cta_title
fields.instructions: Use <em> for one accent phrase.

fields.label: Fallback SEO title (Yoast takes priority)
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: Use only when Yoast SEO is not setting a title. Keep it around 50–60 characters.

fields.label: Fallback meta description (Yoast takes priority)
fields.name: seo_description
fields.instructions: Use only when Yoast SEO is not setting a description. Aim for one clear sentence, about 150–160 characters.

description: Controlled, reusable Search Command Center fields for every Ranked International service page.
